_comment: Every rule the kit's checks can report, with its default severity (Finding, Warn or Info), the guide step it belongs to, and where it comes from: 'Learn' with the guide's footnote key for a Microsoft statement, or 'Design guidance' for the program's own position. A test keeps the rules the code reports equal to this list.

AZS-BL-01.title: Creating management groups doesn't require authorization

AZS-BL-02.title: New subscriptions land in the tenant root group, not a default group

AZS-BL-03.title: A required initiative isn't assigned at the intermediate root

AZS-BL-04.title: A required initiative is assigned in DoNotEnforce (audit), as Step 1 intends

AZS-BL-05.title: A platform resource sends no diagnostic logs to the platform workspace

AZS-BL-06.title: A required Defender for Cloud plan is on the Free tier

AZS-EX-01.title: An exposure has no owner tag

AZS-EX-02.title: A public IP is attached to nothing

AZS-EX-03.title: A new exposure since the previous register

AZS-EX-04.title: An exposure gone since the previous register: check for a dangling DNS record

AZS-EX-05.title: Defender for Cloud reports an internet-exposed resource the register lacks

AZS-DD-01.title: A public IP isn't under DDoS Network Protection or IP Protection

AZS-DD-02.title: A public IP inherits protection from a virtual network the kit can't resolve

AZS-DD-03.title: A public IP on a NAT gateway: DDoS protection doesn't cover it

AZS-DD-04.title: A protected public IP sends no diagnostic logs to the platform workspace

AZS-DD-05.title: A protected public IP has no enabled alert on IfUnderDDoSAttack

AZS-DD-06.title: More than one DDoS protection plan

AZS-WAF-01.title: A WAF policy is in Detection mode or disabled

AZS-WAF-02.title: A WAF policy doesn't inspect the request body

AZS-WAF-03.title: A WAF policy has no Default Rule Set, or one older than the baseline's

AZS-WAF-04.title: A WAF policy has no bot protection rule set

AZS-WAF-05.title: A WAF policy has no rate-limit rule

AZS-WAF-06.title: An application gateway or Front Door profile has no WAF policy

AZS-WAF-07.title: An application gateway or Front Door profile sends no logs to the platform workspace

AZS-WAF-08.title: A Front Door WAF policy isn't Premium, so it can't use managed rule sets

AZS-EDGE-01.title: A classic Front Door profile: it retires March 31, 2027

AZS-EDGE-02.title: An App Service origin can be reached around Front Door

AZS-EDGE-03.title: An origin allows the AzureFrontDoor.Backend tag without checking X-Azure-FDID

AZS-EDGE-04.title: An origin the kit can't check: test its lock-down by hand

AZS-EDGE-05.title: An origin group mixes Private Link and public origins

AZS-EDGE-06.title: A Front Door custom domain allows TLS below 1.2

AZS-EDGE-07.title: An application gateway's TLS policy isn't one of the baseline's predefined policies

AZS-EDGE-08.title: An origin group has fewer than two enabled origins: no failover

AZS-FW-01.title: A firewall policy's threat intelligence isn't in Deny

AZS-FW-02.title: A firewall policy's IDPS isn't in Deny, or the policy isn't Premium

AZS-FW-03.title: A workload subnet has no default route to the firewall

AZS-FW-04.title: A default route goes to a virtual appliance that isn't a known Azure Firewall

AZS-FW-05.title: A firewall sends no logs to the platform workspace

AZS-FW-06.title: A firewall has no firewall policy (classic rules)

AZS-FW-07.title: A Premium firewall policy has no TLS inspection

AZS-PL-01.title: A privatelink DNS zone lives outside the connectivity subscription

AZS-PL-02.title: A privatelink DNS zone isn't linked to the hub virtual network

AZS-PL-03.title: A private endpoint has no DNS zone group

AZS-PL-04.title: A private endpoint registers in a zone outside the connectivity subscription

AZS-PL-05.title: A resource has a private endpoint but public network access is still on

AZS-PL-06.title: A PaaS resource is public and has no private endpoint

AZS-KV-01.title: A vault uses access policies, not Azure RBAC

AZS-KV-02.title: A vault has no purge protection

AZS-KV-03.title: A vault's firewall allows all networks

AZS-KV-04.title: A vault's public network access is on

AZS-KV-05.title: A vault has no approved private endpoint

AZS-KV-06.title: A vault sends no AuditEvent logs to the platform workspace

AZS-POL-01.title: The security initiative isn't assigned at the intermediate root

AZS-POL-02.title: An assignment is still in DoNotEnforce after its enforce-by date

AZS-POL-04.title: An exemption has expired: kept for the record, no longer honored

AZS-POL-05.title: An exemption expires within the warning window

AZS-POL-06.title: An assignment excludes scopes with notScopes
